title: RMT-LLM Laboratory — Infinite Parameter Schema
description: Custom launch system schema. Each parameter supports the full range [0, +inf). Numeric parameters can be int or float. The validator accepts any finite non-negative number as well as the special string 'inf' for true infinity. Includes 3D-visualization and 3D-research parameters introduced in v1.1.0 (manifold geometry, Hessian eigenvalues, trajectory analysis, curvature estimation).

parameters.description: Infinite parameter space. Keys are parameter names. Values define type, range, default. min=0, max=inf by default.

min.description: Lower bound. Use 'inf' or '-inf' for unbounded.

step.description: Step for range type. Use 'inf' for unbounded iteration.

scenarios.description: Pre-defined experimental scenarios with synthetic neural networks

3d_research_parameters.description: Optional parameters introduced in v1.1.0 for 3D visualization and 3D research calculations. All support [0, inf].

manifold_dims.description: Target dimensionality for manifold projection (PCA/t-SNE/UMAP). 3 = 3D plot.

hessian_grid_size.description: Grid resolution for 3D Hessian / loss-landscape scan. Higher = smoother 3D surface but O(n^2) cost.

trajectory_points.description: Number of points along the 3D reasoning-trace trajectory (time × honesty × spectral).

curvature_neighbors.description: Neighbors used for Riemannian curvature estimation on the hidden-state manifold.

spectral_surface_layers.description: Layers to include in the 3D spectral-surface plot (layer × token × eigenvalue).

pca_components.description: Number of principal components for 3D PCA visualization.

attention_flow_3d_resolution.description: Resolution of the 3D attention-flow vector field (x = query pos, y = key pos, z = attention weight).

parameter_space_grid.description: Grid resolution for 3D parameter-space sweep (temperature × top_p × hallucination_rate).
